description: This file manages macOS launch agents and daemons for the openclaw gateway, including functions for resolving paths, reading status, installing, uninstalling, and restarting launch agents, with support for legacy agents and error handling.

methods.name: resolveLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Determines the launch agent label based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: resolveLaunchAgentPlistPathForLabel
methods.description: Constructs the full path to the launch agent plist file for a given label.

methods.name: resolveLaunchAgentPlistPath
methods.description: Resolves the launch agent plist path based on environment.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLogPaths
methods.description: Provides paths for gateway log files based on environment.

methods.name: readLaunchAgentProgramArguments
methods.description: Reads the program arguments from the launch agent plist file.

methods.name: buildLaunchAgentPlist
methods.description: Builds the plist content for a launch agent with specified parameters.

methods.name: execLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes the launchctl command with given arguments, handling platform differences.

methods.name: parseGatewayPortFromProgramArguments
methods.description: Extracts the port number from program arguments.

methods.name: resolveLaunchAgentGatewayPort
methods.description: Determines the gateway port from program arguments or environment variable.

methods.name: resolveGuiDomain
methods.description: Returns the GUI domain string based on process UID or default.

methods.name: throwBootstrapGuiSessionError
methods.description: Throws an error indicating a GUI session is required for bootstrap.

methods.name: writeLaunchAgentActionLine
methods.description: Writes a formatted line to stdout for logging actions.

methods.name: bootstrapLaunchAgentOrThrow
methods.description: Bootstraps a launch agent and throws on failure.

methods.name: ensureSecureDirectory
methods.description: Creates directory with secure permissions, tightening mode if necessary.

methods.name: parseLaunchctlPrint
methods.description: Parses output from launchctl print into structured info.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a launch agent is loaded.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentListed
methods.description: Checks if a launch agent is listed.

methods.name: launchAgentPlistExists
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent plist file exists.

methods.name: readLaunchAgentRuntime
methods.description: Reads runtime status of the launch agent.

methods.name: repairLaunchAgentBootstrap
methods.description: Attempts to repair bootstrap of launch agent.

methods.name: findLegacyLaunchAgents
methods.description: Finds legacy launch agents for cleanup or removal.

methods.name: uninstallLegacyLaunchAgents
methods.description: Uninstalls legacy launch agents, moving plist files to Trash.

methods.name: uninstallLaunchAgent
methods.description: Uninstalls the current launch agent, moving plist to Trash.

methods.name: stopLaunchAgent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent.

methods.name: writeLaunchAgentPlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file.

methods.name: stageLaunchAgent
methods.description: Prepares and stages the launch agent for installation.

methods.name: activateLaunchAgent
methods.description: Activates (boots and unloads) the launch agent.

methods.name: installLaunchAgent
methods.description: Installs and activates the launch agent.

methods.name: restartLaunchAgent
methods.description: Restarts the launch agent, scheduling or performing a kickstart.
